previous_description: A JSON Schema $ref pointer that references another schema by URI or JSON Pointer fragment, enabling schema reuse without duplication. In JSON Schema Draft 7, all sibling keywords alongside $ref are ignored — use allOf to combine a $ref with additional constraints.
definition: A schema node whose only effective content is a $ref keyword holding a URI or JSON Pointer fragment (e.g. '#/definitions/Address') that delegates validation of an instance to another schema, adding no constraints of its own. A usage site that points at a type declared elsewhere, not the declaration of that type.

distinguish_from.when: the element is the named, reusable type being pointed at (the target under 'definitions'), rather than the pointer to it
the element is a named property of an object schema that also carries its own type, description, default or other constraints, even if it uses $ref to obtain its type
the $ref must be combined with further constraints or alternatives, which in Draft 7 requires wrapping it in allOf/anyOf/oneOf
the element is the whole root schema document with $schema and $id, not a pointer into or toward one

standard_reference: JSON Schema Draft 7 (draft-handrews-json-schema-01) §8.3 Schema References With "$ref"
code_evidence: A literal "$ref": "#/definitions/..." or "$ref": "other.schema.json#/..." entry in a JSON/YAML schema or an OpenAPI components file
A field in a DTO, Pydantic model or TypeScript interface typed by another separately declared model class (e.g. 'billing: Address'), which schema generators emit as a $ref

Schema-generator configuration or decorators that hoist nested types into shared definitions, such as Pydantic's ref_template, zod-to-json-schema $refStrategy, or @ApiProperty({ type: () => Address })
notes: The maps-to application.applicationservice relationship looks wrong, because a schema pointer does not realise a service. SchemaProperty also carries a $ref attribute, so the boundary is fuzzy. There is no attribute that distinguishes internal fragment references from external URI references. The 'references' target is limited to schemadefinition, but a $ref may also point at a jsonschema root or another external schema.
